Pixel OS v1.7.0 — 1:1 iOS 26 Lock Screen, Dock-Grade Liquid Glass & Zero-Glitch Gestures on Android 17 for Realme X2 Pro (RMX1931)
• New 1:1 iOS 26 Liquid Glass Lock Screen (IosControlCenter v1.7.0-ios26): oversized hero refractive Liquid Glass clock, circular widgets, stacked bottom notifications, expanded Apple Music platter, Goodix G3 optical UDFPS zone, and Flashlight/Camera droplets + customization in Settings -> Wallpaper & Lock Screen
• Calibrated Control Center & Notification Center AGSL Liquid Glass 1:1 to the Home Screen Dock (calm 20% circleMap meniscus refraction & frost, subtle 2.35dp dispersion, zero heavy inner groove/wall glare, and hair-fine 0.58dp 34° specular rim)
• Eliminated the 1% visible -> blanking glitch on both left and right pull-downs (removed shade-collapse self-dismiss feedback loop, monotonic swipe sequence guard, and window-focus handoff protection in NexusLauncherRelease v17.7.0-ios26)
• Fixed left Notification Center & right Control Center swipe-up-to-close via 90Hz NestedScrollConnection + PointerEventPass.Final + Home Bar velocity tracking
